project.title: Bacterial strains isolated from the Mars-analog Qaidam Basin soils and bioaerosols exposed to Earth's near space
project.description: Earth's near space with combined polyextreme conditions serves as a unique Mars analog for astrobiology research, such as biological exposure experiments, to investigate life's resistance to Mars-like environments.
project.center_name: Institute of Geology and Geophysics, Chinese Academy of Sciences

samples: environmental sample; urban association not established
runs: 16S rRNA gene amplicon of the Qaidam Basin bioaerosol
